** Minor** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win**
Supported by static analysis

Web query: `Can Microsoft Graph search/query return an empty hits collection with moreResultsAvailable=true for site or listItem searches, and how should the next offset be calculated?` Result: ``` Sources consulted: - Use the Microsoft Search API to query data - Microsoft Graph v1.0 | Microsoft Learn — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/search-api-overview?view=graph-rest-1.0 - searchHitsContainer resource type - Microsoft Graph v1.0 | Microsoft Learn — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/searchhitscontainer?view=graph-rest-1.0 - searchRequest resource type - Microsoft Graph v1.0 | Microsoft Learn — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/searchrequest?view=graph-rest-1.0 - …and 21 more ``` --- Script executed: ```bash rg -n -F -e 'raw_count' -e 'more_results_available' -e 'has_more' -e 'next_skip' -- backend/python/app/sources/external/microsoft/sharepoint/sharepoint.py backend/python/app/agents/actions/microsoft/sharepoint/sharepoint.py || test "$?" -eq 1 echo "--- sources sharepoint.py 300-440 ---" nl -ba backend/python/app/sources/external/microsoft/sharepoint/sharepoint.py | sed -n '300,440p' echo "--- actions sharepoint.py 480-530 ---" nl -ba backend/python/app/agents/actions/microsoft/sharepoint/sharepoint.py | sed -n '480,530p' echo "--- actions sharepoint.py 680-730 ---" nl -ba backend/python/app/agents/actions/microsoft/sharepoint/sharepoint.py | sed -n '680,730p' ``` Repository: pipeshub-ai/pipeshub-ai Length of output: 19190 ---
**Stop paging when a search response returns no hits.** When Graph returns no hits with `more_results_available=True`, both search methods return `raw_count=0`. The actions then set `has_more=True` from the flag. `next_skip` stays equal to the current `skip`, so the output tells the caller to request the same offset again. This affects `get_sites` at `sharepoint.py:558-572` and `search_pages` at `sharepoint.py:763-778`. Microsoft's documentation does not state whether `site` or `listItem` queries can return this combination. The code path is still feasible if Graph returns it. Stop when no hits were consumed, so the cursor cannot repeat unchanged.
🛠️ Suggested fix

```diff @@ get_sites (sharepoint.py ~line 561) - has_more = bool(more_available) if more_available is not None else len(sites) == page_size + has_more = (bool(more_available) if more_available is not None else len(sites) == page_size) and int(data.get("raw_count") or 0) > 0 @@ search_pages (sharepoint.py ~line 766) - has_more = bool(more_available) if more_available is not None else len(pages) == page_size + has_more = (bool(more_available) if more_available is not None else len(pages) == page_size) and int(data.get("raw_count") or 0) > 0 ```
